title: After Operation Safed Sagar, Mihir Ahuja explores family drama with Dilwali Diwali
text:
Mihir Ahuja talks about career choices and his new film Dilwali Diwali 
 Home / Entertainment / Bollywood News / Article / After Operation Safed Sagar, Mihir Ahuja explores family drama with Dilwali Diwali 
 After Operation Safed Sagar, Mihir Ahuja explores family drama with Dilwali Diwali
 Updated On: 01 November, 2026 07:12 AM IST | Mumbai | Mohar Basu 
 After exploring the intense world of military drama with Operation Safed Sagar, Mihir Ahuja is all set to charm audiences with Netflix's family entertainer Dilwali Diwali. The actor opens up about what drew him to the film, his career choices and the importance of exploring diverse roles.
 Listen to this article : Mihir Ahuja
 After the intense military drama Operation Safed Sagar, Mihir Ahuja switches gears with Netflix’s family drama Dilwali Diwali.
 Centred on a quirky Punjabi family, the film draws inspiration from the relatable thought that ‘ home is where the heart is ’. “The emotional heart of the story drew me in. I think there is something incredibly beautiful about stories that remind us that home is not just a place; it is the people who make us feel that we belong,” says Ahuja, who plays the lead.
